canDoYue: 你識講遲到、上車站、車牌、中途改目的地、用卡付同埋攞收據。
canDoEn: Say you are running late, give the pick-up point and plate number, change the destination, pay by card, and keep the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I am running late now, and my taxi pick-up point is the hotel door.
dialogue.glossYue: 我而家遲到，的士上車站係酒店門口。
dialogue.say: I am running late now, and my taxi pick-up point is the hotel door.

dialogue.speaker: ray
dialogue.text: I can see the pick-up point, and the plate number is blue four two.
dialogue.glossYue: 我見到上車站，車牌係藍四二。
dialogue.say: I can see the pick-up point, and the plate number is blue four two.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can we change the destination on the way, and may I pay by card please?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以中途改目的地，同埋用卡付？
dialogue.say: Can we change the destination on the way, and may I pay by card please?

dialogue.speaker: ray
dialogue.text: Yes we can change that destination now, and card payment is fine for you here.
dialogue.glossYue: 而家可以改目的地，用卡付都得。
dialogue.say: Yes we can change that destination now, and card payment is fine for you here.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What is the full plate number, and can you send me a written receipt please?
dialogue.glossYue: 車牌係幾多，可唔可以畀張收據我？
dialogue.say: What is the full plate number, and can you send me a written receipt please?

dialogue.speaker: ray
dialogue.text: Your receipt is saved on this phone app, and the blue car is four two.
dialogue.glossYue: 收據喺呢個電話程式，藍色車係四二。
dialogue.say: Your receipt is saved on this phone app, and the blue car is four two.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will wait at the hotel pick-up point until the blue car arrives there.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會喺酒店上車站等，直至藍色車到。
dialogue.say: I will wait at the hotel pick-up point until the blue car arrives there.

dialogue.speaker: ray
dialogue.text: Please watch for the blue car at the door, and the receipt stays on your phone.
dialogue.glossYue: 請留意門口藍色車，收據會留喺你部電話。
dialogue.say: Please watch for the blue car at the door, and the receipt stays on your phone.

understand.prompt: Can we change the destination on the way, and may I pay by card please? 即係問緊咩？
choices: 問可唔可以改目的地，用卡付
understand.explain: destination 係目的地。card 係卡。

understand.prompt: What is the full plate number, and can you send me a written receipt please? 即係問緊咩？
choices: 問車牌同可唔可以畀收據
understand.explain: plate number 係車牌。receipt 係收據。
